The '''U-20 Kingstrike''' was a high power precision [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] family [[House Ulgo]]. It was a newly created precision weapon with these cannons capable of being fitted onto a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] as well as giving them the capacity from striking a target from orbit with perfect accuracy.

[[Kamen Proy]] who was an agent for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] was undercover in House Ulgo where he learnt of the completion of the weapon. Proy later attempted to find a representative from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to inform them of this threat as the Kingstrike was being dismantled for being shipped offworld from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

This individual was tasked by Proy to journey to the [[Ulgo Shipping Facility]] at [[King's Pass]] in order to recover the dismantled laser cannon before it was moved.
